task.description: Check one generic public scientific-topic query can return a bounded set of Europe PMC metadata rows and exercise default-off/minimal route selection.

live_tool_trial.claim_ceiling: One live provider response returned three metadata rows for one public query at this retrieval time; this does not establish query relevance, completeness, source authenticity, scientific support, or article status.

input_types: UTF-8 JSON stdin object with exactly a public query string (1-512 characters) and integer max_results (1-10)
required_outputs: at most ten Europe PMC provider-ranked lite publication metadata rows with source, provider ID, DOI/PMID/PMCID when present, title, author string, journal and publication year
query SHA-256, response SHA-256, retrieval timestamp, provider hit count, returned count, HTTP and acquisition status, and bounded claim ceiling

neighbor_contracts.input_scope: Caller-supplied DOI plus expected title and year
neighbor_contracts.output_scope: Comparison rows against one Crossref record
PMID and PMCID mapping when returned
Raw Comments/Corrections relations recorded for those records
Selected arXiv provider metadata for that identifier

neighbor_contracts.input_scope: Already-collected Crossref and OpenAlex adapter results for one DOI
neighbor_contracts.output_scope: Local title/year field agreement, disagreement or insufficiency; no retrieval
Deterministic source brief from checked-out asset-card corpus

neighbor_contracts.input_scope: Caller-declared requirements and literal terms against checked-out Knowledge index
neighbor_contracts.output_scope: Bounded current raw source lines and unresolved navigation gaps; no sufficiency decision

comparison_scope.distinct_inputs_and_outputs: Europe PMC topic query to bounded external record discovery does not replace known-identifier Crossref/OpenAlex/PubMed/arXiv operations, local comparison of two already-collected provider results, or local source navigation over declared cluster IDs and the checked-out Knowledge corpus.
unmeasured: completeness against other databases or search strategies
comparison_scope.retirement_decision: No existing component is deprecated or retired by this evidence.

candidate_catalog_refresh.note: The context-packet comparator was added as a default-off local option. The recorded Europe PMC live response is historical; the three route trial expectations are rechecked by the focused routing test against this refreshed candidate catalog.
